name: Peach Belt Conference Cross Country Championships
where: Macon, GA · host Middle Georgia State · Georgia Premier Cross Country Course
headline: Peach Belt Conference Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Augusta swept the titles, edging Flagler 40-43 for the women’s crown and winning the men’s with 27 to Flagler’s 44. Augusta’s Gabby Jourdain won the women’s 5K in 17:59.6 and Flagler’s Axel Dabe the men’s 8K in 25:35.5.
